question: Should OpenClaw publish a public OpenAPI/Swagger contract for Gateway programmatic access, and if so should it be a static artifact, a runtime endpoint, or a documented TypeBox/JSON Schema client-generation path?
rationale: The choice defines externally supported endpoints, auth visibility, versioning, and generated-client compatibility, so automation should not pick the API contract shape without maintainer intent.

options.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
options.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide schema format, exposure path, endpoint coverage, auth metadata, and versioning before implementation.

options.title: Narrow To Static Artifact
options.body: Publish a release-attached or committed schema for client generation without adding a new runtime endpoint yet.

options.title: Use Existing Protocol Docs Instead
options.body: Close later only if maintainers decide the TypeBox/JSON Schema pipeline and Gateway protocol/RPC docs are the intended client-generation surface.

recommendation.title: Design Public Schema Contract First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while maintainers decide schema format, exposure path, endpoint coverage, auth metadata, and versioning before implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc has the closest prior OpenAPI artifact work and recent Gateway HTTP endpoint history for this exact direction.
